# Fashion West Ukraine

> Fashion West Ukraine (FWU) is a national next-generation fashion platform uniting fashion, business, art and strategic collaborations. FWU operates seasonally across western Ukrainian cities (Uzhhorod, Mukachevo, Lviv) with a curated roster of ~20 Ukrainian designers, runway showcases, pop-up selections, journal, and partner programs. Launched 2024.

## Key pages

- [Home (UA)](https://fashionwestukraine.com/): Platform manifesto, current designers, upcoming events.
- [Home (EN)](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en): English landing page.
- [About FWU](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/about): Mission, ecosystem, sections (Platform, Community, Media, Expo, Education, International).
- [Designers](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/designers): Curated directory of 20 Ukrainian fashion brands on the platform.
- [Pop-Up Selection](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/pop-up): Curated selection of pieces — not a shop, a space of selected fashion.
- [Projects](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/projects): Runway shows, models program, hackathon, international, education.
- [Partners](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/partners): Brand, media, education, venue, logistics partners.
- [Collaboration](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/collaboration): Working directions for designers, brands, media, sponsors, international.
- [FWU 2026 event](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/event/2026): 2 May 2026, Mukachevo, Darlin Hall — runways, networking, cultural stage.
- [Contacts](https://fashionwestukraine.com/en/contacts): Reach via @fw.ukraine and @fw.cooperation on Instagram.
